dct:provenance:
RCP_KB_NAME resolved exactly one knowledge_bases entry: ClinPGx, configured discovery root https://www.clinpgx.org/downloads.
The JavaScript-rendered downloads application was traversed through its official ClinPGx API catalog at https://api.clinpgx.org/v1/data/file/data/?view=min and official ClinPGx-linked attachment/submission URLs; no GitHub repository or public Croissant metadata was used as a metadata source.
All 133 discovered downloadable parent assets resolved successfully and were downloaded (137912702 bytes).
50 ZIP archives were inspected without modifying the originals; 1687 relevant members are represented as child cr:FileObject entries. Each child contentUrl uses the deterministic form parent-archive-name!/exact/archive-relative-member-path and its containedIn reference identifies the verified remote parent archive.
1393 cr:RecordSet entries were derived only where an in-band header, explicit commented schema, observed JSON object keys, or first-worksheet XLSX header could be mapped to the represented file. Datatype inference sampled no more than five data rows. Detection methods: {"in-band XLSX header": 238, "in-band header": 391, "observed JSON keys": 764}.
56 structured candidates lacked a reliable supported mapping (including legacy binary XLS files, headerless BED data, or irregular files); fields were omitted rather than invented.
